query:
SELECT empresaSlug, COUNT(*) as registros
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI', 'mascote', 'morumbi', 'barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-morumbi')
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
